changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Ver historia clinica' AS name, 'clinicalHistory.read' AS code, 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear consultas', 'consultation.create', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver consultas', 'consultation.read', 'CLINICAL_HISTORY'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear desparasitaciones', 'deworming.create', 'DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver desparasitaciones', 'deworming.read', 'DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar desparasitaciones', 'deworming.update', 'DEWORMING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar desparasitaciones', 'deworming.delete', 'DEWORMING'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear imagenes diagnosticas', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver imagenes diagnosticas', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar imagenes diagnosticas', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar imagenes diagnosticas', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear hospitalizaciones', 'hospitalization.create', 'HOSPITALIZATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver hospitalizaciones', 'hospitalization.read', 'HOSPITALIZATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar hospitalizaciones', 'hospitalization.update', 'HOSPITALIZATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar hospitalizaciones', 'hospitalization.delete', 'HOSPITALIZATION'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear examenes de laboratorio', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'LABORATORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver examenes de laboratorio', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'LABORATORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar examenes de laboratorio', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'LABORATORY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar examenes de laboratorio', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'LABORATORY'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear prescripcion de medicamento', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'MEDICAMENTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear prescripciones', 'prescription.create', 'MEDICAMENTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver prescripciones', 'prescription.read', 'MEDICAMENTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar prescripciones', 'prescription.update', 'MEDICAMENTS' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar prescripciones', 'prescription.delete', 'MEDICAMENTS'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear servicios de spa', 'spa.create', 'SPA' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver servicios de spa', 'spa.read', 'SPA' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar servicios de spa', 'spa.update', 'SPA' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar servicios de spa', 'spa.delete', 'SPA'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear cirugias', 'surgery.create', 'SURGERY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver cirugias', 'surgery.read', 'SURGERY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar cirugias', 'surgery.update', 'SURGERY' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar cirugias', 'surgery.delete', 'SURGERY'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Crear vacunaciones', 'vaccination.create', 'VACCINATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver vacunaciones', 'vaccination.read', 'VACCINATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Editar vacunaciones', 'vaccination.update', 'VACCINATION' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eliminar vacunaciones', 'vaccination.delete', 'VACCINATION' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.create', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.read', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.read', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.read', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.read', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.read', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.read', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.create', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.read', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.read', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.read', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.read', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.read', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.read', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.create', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.read', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.read', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.read', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.read', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.read', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.read', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'DEWORMING', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING', 'HOSPITALIZATION', 'LABORATORY', 'MEDICAMENTS', 'SPA', 'SURGERY', 'VACCINATION') WHERE ce.access_level IN ('FULL', 'READ_ONLY') AND bp.code IN ('clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.read', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'hospitalization.read', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'prescription.read', 'spa.read', 'surgery.read', 'vaccination.read') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.read', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'hospitalization.read', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'prescription.read', 'spa.read', 'surgery.read', 'vaccination.read');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, bp.sub_module_id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.sub_module_id = ce.sub_module_id JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = bp.sub_module_id AND sm.code IN ('CLINICAL_HISTORY', 'DEWORMING', 'DIAGNOSTIC_IMAGING', 'HOSPITALIZATION', 'LABORATORY', 'MEDICAMENTS', 'SPA', 'SURGERY', 'VACCINATION') WHERE ce.access_level = 'FULL' AND bp.code IN ('consultation.create', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM permissions WHERE code IN ('consultation.create', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete');

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ( 'clinicalHistory.read', 'consultation.create', 'consultation.read', 'deworming.create', 'deworming.read', 'deworming.update', 'deworming.delete', 'diagnosticimaging.create', 'diagnosticimaging.read', 'diagnosticimaging.update', 'diagnosticimaging.delete', 'hospitalization.create', 'hospitalization.read', 'hospitalization.update', 'hospitalization.delete', 'laboratoryTest.create', 'laboratoryTest.read', 'laboratoryTest.update', 'laboratoryTest.delete', 'medicamentPrescription.create', 'prescription.create', 'prescription.read', 'prescription.update', 'prescription.delete', 'spa.create', 'spa.read', 'spa.update', 'spa.delete', 'surgery.create', 'surgery.read', 'surgery.update', 'surgery.delete', 'vaccination.create', 'vaccination.read', 'vaccination.update', 'vaccination.delete') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
